description: Group minor, patch, pin and digest updates (npm/bun, GH Actions, Docker) into one PR, then auto-merge when the full e2e + unit + docker CI gate is green — keeps the 288-test e2e suite from running once per package.
Major bumps land one per PR and auto-merge ONLY on a fully green CI gate (e2e + unit + docker) — CI is the safety net for majors, exactly like minors.

TypeScript is held back until vue-tsc (@vue/language-tools) ships support for TS 7's native Go compiler (vuejs/language-tools#6124): vue-tsc imports typescript/lib/tsc, removed in TS 7, so the build dies with ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED. Remove this restriction when vue-tsc supports TS 7.
